## Description

Create `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-verifier.md` — the new sub-agent that inspects absence-claim findings by checking the cited file at the evidence command output, then emits structured rulings with fingerprints.

## Done Definitions

- File exists at `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-verifier.md`
- Agent frontmatter: `name: code-reviewer-verifier`, `model: sonnet`
- Ruling output schema documented and required:
  ```json
  {
    "finding_id": "<from input>",
    "ruling": "confirm | downgrade-to-minor | drop",
    "fingerprint": "<path>:<line-start>-<line-end>",
    "verifier_status": "ok | failed",
    "evidence_invalidated": true | false,
    "rationale": "<one-sentence explanation>"
  }
  ```
- Fingerprint schema specifies:
  - Normal case: `<path>:<line-start>-<line-end>`, `line-start == line-end` for single-line findings
  - Multi-file finding: one fingerprint object per file
  - Missing-line-anchor (missing-file claim, deleted file): `<path>:0-0` sentinel
  - Validator rejects fingerprints where line-start > line-end or format is malformed
- Rubric documented:
  - `confirm`: uncertainty about the claim — pass through unchanged to autonomous-resolution loop
  - `drop`: finding is verifiably false (e.g., code exists at the cited location contradicting the absence claim)
  - `downgrade-to-minor`: claim is factually correct but scope/severity/reachability overstated
  - Never drop on insufficient evidence — confirm instead (fail-open on uncertainty)
- Brainstorm probe handling explicitly documented:
  - Probe 1 (clear contradiction): `verification_evidence.output` shows code exists at cited location → DROP
  - Probe 2 (authoritative tone): finding uses "X is never ..." but evidence shows X → DROP
  - Probe 3 (genuine ambiguity): evidence is inconclusive → CONFIRM + rationale notes uncertainty
- Failure handling: if agent cannot complete verification (timeout, missing evidence, API error), emit `verifier_status: failed`, set ruling to `confirm`, pass through fail-open
- Running `tests/agents/test-code-reviewer-verifier-agent.sh` exits 0 after this task
